questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Discrete Fourier Transform & Properties, Circular Convolution
questions.text: Define Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) ($X[k] = \sum_{n=0}^{N-1} x[n] W_N^{kn}$) and Inverse DFT.
